artworks.title: Orpheus and Eurydice
artworks.medium: black and white chalk with traces of graphite on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-body figures. On the left is a person standing upright, wearing a long, flowing garment that covers them from neck to feet, with elaborate folds and draping. Their head is adorned with a wreath, and they have a contemplative expression. Their right hand is slightly raised, with fingers pointing. To the right, there is a fully nude figure in a contrapposto stance, with one leg slightly bent and the left foot raised. This figure rests their left hand on their hip and holds a rectangular object at their side with their right hand. They have curly hair and a direct gaze. Both figures are drawn in tones of white and black chalk on a brownish-ochre paper. Behind them, there is a plain background. The initials "E.B.J." are visible on the lower right.

artworks.title: Allegorical Figures Seen from Below
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red wash, heightened with white, over red chalk
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various mythical or allegorical figures in dynamic poses. The drawing features several figures floating or flying across the composition, with swirling lines and fluid motion. Drapery and rhythmic lines emphasize the figures’ movement. The artist used a reddish sepia tone with soft shading to create the image, adding touches of blue to highlight parts of the garments. The figures are expressive, each carrying out different gestures. The positioning of these figures suggests a scene of mythological significance, with some appearing to hold objects like wings or instruments. The background is minimally detailed, making the figures the focal point of the composition.

artworks.title: Seated Male Nude [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 16.8 x 17.5 cm (6 5/8 x 6 7/8 in.)
support: 17.8 x 18.2 cm (7 x 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a seated male figure. The man is angled with his body facing slightly to the left, left arm extended outward, pointing with one finger. His right arm is bent, resting on his knee. The figure has a full beard and long, wavy hair flowing past his shoulders. His facial features are detailed yet not fully defined. The man is clothed in flowing garments that partially cover his muscular form, leaving his legs exposed. He is seated on an implied chair or throne, indicated by lines and shading behind him. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain with no additional elements.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child with Saints John and Luke
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash over red chalk
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This image shows a group of serene figures and cherubs gathered around a grand tree. A central figure is holding a child, both with halos above their heads. The scene is filled with cherubic figures interacting around the main characters, with some hovering in the air. The tree is lush with foliage, extending upwards with cherubic figures among its branches. In the background, there are detailed architectural structures, contributing to the tranquil and natural atmosphere of the scene. The drawing is created with fine linework and subtle shading, resulting in a harmonious and intricate depiction.

artworks.title: Two Seated Male Figures
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sketch shows two individuals in a seated position, with their full bodies slightly angled towards each other. Their facial features are depicted with simple lines and minimal detail. The hair of the individuals is represented with a few lines. The clothing appears to be long robes or cloaks, characterized by flowing, draped lines. There is no jewelry or specific objects in their hands. The background of the image is plain. The overall atmosphere of the sketch is informal and rough.

artworks.title: Female Saint Carrying a Banner [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a full-body sketch of a figure standing in an elevated position. The person is holding a large object across their shoulders with both hands. Their head is tilted back slightly, and the facial features are soft with closed eyes. The hair is short and loose. They are draped in flowing garments suggestive of robes. No jewelry is visible. Additional faint figures and forms appear in the background. The background is empty apart from these light sketches, providing focus on the main figure. The artwork is monochromatic with reddish-brown tones.

artworks.title: The Apotheosis of San Vitale
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Emma P. and Fred Ziprik Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures on clouds within a circular frame. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses, with various smaller winged characters around them. One central figure stands out, with others interacting around them. The composition evokes a sense of energy and movement, with detailed line work and shading creating depth and motion in the celestial scene.

artworks.title: Fancy Pitcher
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and yellow wash
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Emma P. and Fred Ziprik Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts an ornate vessel with intricate designs. The vessel is highly decorative, featuring a sculpted lion perched on top with a long tail curling upwards. The body of the vessel showcases elaborate figures, including mythological beings and scrollwork, all rendered with delicate lines and fine detailing. The vessel appears to combine elements of classical art with fantasy, exhibiting a baroque or possibly Renaissance style of ornamentation. The level of detail and complexity highlights the artist's focus on imaginative and highly decorative compositions.

artworks.title: Allegory of Summer
artworks.medium: pen and India ink with black wash and graphite on five sheets of thin graph paper; partially squaredin graphite
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This composition features central geometric rectangles with curved and flowing lines. A square at the center swirls dynamically, surrounded by a curled form resembling movement. Two elongated figures stand on either side, with limbs stretching upwards. Below, a rectangular panel shows a reclining figure in a serene posture. The image blends abstract shapes with human forms and gestures.

artworks.title: The Peep-Show
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and yellow-brown washes over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This drawing shows multiple figures around a large box structure. The group of individuals are focused on the box, some objects are on the ground nearby. The figures are looking into the box with interest. The drawing features expressive lines and details depicting the curiosity of the scene.

artworks.title: Travellers among Roman Ruins
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red-brown and blue wash, incised for transfer
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 21.1 x 23.6 cm (8 5/16 x 9 5/16 in.)
image (diameter): 19.8 cm (7 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape enclosed within an oval frame, presenting a historical scene with Roman-style ruins. In the foreground, three figures stand near a rocky area. To the right, people with livestock move along a path. In the background, tall columns and partial structures stand among smaller human figures. The horizon slopes gently upward, with distant buildings, ruins, and trees under a softly clouded sky. The image features delicate brushwork, fine lines, and subtle shading, with an earthy color palette dominated by soft sepia tones, browns, oranges, and greys contrasting with the pale blue sky.

artworks.title: Travellers among Roman Ruins
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red-brown and blue wash, indented with stylus
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a view of ancient ruins in an oval frame, capturing a high perspective. The horizon is positioned high with remnants of towers and structures merging with the sky. Brushstrokes depict detailed textures of the architecture and surrounding foliage. The color palette consists of earthy tones, with hints of blues in the sky. Small figures walk along a path near the ruins, adding scale and life to the scene. In the distance, archways and walls fade into the sky.

artworks.title: View near Rosora di Serra San Quirico
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened in white on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Stoddard M. Stevens Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with hills, a row of trees along the horizon, a brick structure with medieval architecture, natural elements like hills and trees extending into the distance, a curving path leading to the structure, a river with animals nearby, and two small figures walking along the path. The painting is detailed, featuring different brushstrokes for foliage and land/water, and uses a sepia color palette with dark browns for shadows and lighter tones for open areas.

artworks.title: Studies of Market Figures
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various scenes involving wagons and horses. The image depicts numerous figures engaged in everyday activities, with a variety of wagons drawn by horses scattered throughout the scene. The composition is busy, showcasing individuals in different poses, some interacting with each other, while others are seen carrying goods or tending to their animals. The sketch includes intricate details of the wagons, horses, and items being carried or transported, rendered in fine pencil or ink lines. The overall impression is lively, capturing a snapshot of daily life with a focus on movement and the bustle of a community.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Apollonia
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in intense interaction, some nude or partially clothed. The composition shows dynamic motion, with figures contorting and reaching out in various gestures. The central focus is a struggle or confrontation between the figures, with one figure pierced by a spear or sword, while others seem to assist or oppose. Above them floats a cherubic or angelic figure with wings. The scene is monochromatic, using shades of brown ink and washes on a cream background, giving it a classical feel. The drawing conveys tension and movement through the interplay of figures and the use of shadow and highlight.

artworks.title: Mrs. Richard Brinsley Sheridan
artworks.artist: Samuel Arlent Edwards after Thomas Gainsborough
artworks.medium: color mezzotint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of S. Arlent Edwards, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, facing forward. She is wearing a light-colored dress with three-quarter length sleeves and a red sash around her waist. Her hand rests on her lap. She has dark, curly hair tied with a red ribbon and a sheer scarf over her shoulders. The background features lush foliage, water, and a colorful sky. The portrait is contained within an oval frame.

artworks.title: Harbor in Holland - Flushing (La balise - En Holland, Flessingue)
artworks.medium: etching in blue-green on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The low vantage point shows a rowboat on the right and a large triangular structure on the left, with the water in the foreground and buildings in the distance. The etching technique captures the scene with detailed lines. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of blue.

artworks.title: Cattle and Figures at a Farmyard Stream
artworks.medium: etching on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a body of water, cattle drinking, a thatched-roof structure, abundant trees, rolling hills, buildings in the distance, a person on horseback, and a winding path. The engraving has finely detailed textures in varying shades of grayscale, depicting a classic and serene landscape with a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Squandering His Inheritance on Harlots
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.medium: woodcut on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered together in an intricate scene. The figures are wearing classical attire and are positioned around a seated central figure. The figures have expressive postures. The background features an architectural setting with an archway leading to an outdoor scene. Additionally, there is a table with a decorative pitcher, a stringed instrument, and foliage. The use of line work creates texture and depth.

artworks.title: Joseph Awakened by the Angel
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.7 x 18.9 cm (5 3/8 x 7 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image displays an etching featuring a woman standing or kneeling on the right side, with her body slightly turned, head lowered, and hands holding a swaddled infant. Her head is covered with a draped cloth, and she is wearing flowing robes. On the left side, there are figures, one of which seems to have wings. The scene is set in a rustic setting with animals in the foreground, including a donkey. The background is sketched with lines and hatching for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Antwerp Cathedral
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 48.6 x 33.6 cm (19 1/8 x 13 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a cathedral in the center, surrounded by other buildings and people below. The cathedral is intricately detailed with fine lines, set against a monochrome color palette of black and grey. The sky has clouds, adding to the grandeur of the scene.

artworks.title: Cite Lointaine
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a aerial view of a landscape with a valley between rocky cliffs. The scene includes a cityscape in the distance, detailed and textured etching depicting rocks, water, and vegetation, a monochromatic sepia color palette, a body of water with surrounding tall grasses, buildings in the distance, and a sky with soft clouds.

artworks.title: At the Prado (Au Prado)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures, primarily focusing on one person in the foreground. This person is depicted from head to toe, standing upright with a slight turn of the body to their right. Their facial features are gently sketched with a soft expression, and their hair is mostly covered by a large, dark headscarf or hood. Their clothing is a long, dark, full-skirted garment that covers them entirely down to the ground. One of their hands is visible and holds a dark object, possibly a bag or a muff, and the other hand holds what appears to be a light-colored handkerchief or similar item. Surrounding the central figure, there are other individuals in the background wearing hats and dark clothing, seemingly forming a gathering or procession. The background is textured with dark, abstract shapes, set against a light sky. Two small poodle-like dogs are at the feet of the central figure.

artworks.title: Saint-Etienne-du-Mont, Paris (Church of St. Stephen of the Mount, Paris)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene featuring a historic church or cathedral. The image displays gothic architecture with detailed elements, such as stone carvings, arched windows, a large circular window, and a central clock tower. Additional buildings with elaborate facades flank the structure. Construction activity is shown with scaffolding on one side. The line work is precise and fine, creating textures and shadows. The drawing captures the beauty and intricacy of the architecture, evoking a sense of timelessness and reverence for historical design.
